meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: Search claude-mem's persistent cross-session memory database. Use when user asks "did we already solve this?", "how did we do X last time?", or needs work from previous sessions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把之前交流时确定的方案和说法直接找回来
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常和AI助手连续协作,却不时忘记上次聊过的结论
copy.tagline_en: Bring back the solution discussed in a previous session with one question
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often work with an AI assistant across sessions and forget past conclusions

howto.what: Claude 能检索 claude-mem 跨会话记忆库:先按关键词搜出带 ID 的索引,再看某条命中前后的时间线,只对筛出的 ID 取完整详情,必要时才取原始工具输入输出。
howto.when: 当你问起之前会话的事,比如「这个问题是不是已经解决了?」「上次怎么做的?」或需要上周的工作记录时触发。

say.text: 上次我们是怎么解决 JWT 认证问题的?
say.note: 先搜索引,再按需取完整详情

say.text: 搜一下 my-project 里最近的 bugfix
say.note: 返回带 ID 的结果表

say.text: 看看 11131 这条记录前后发生了什么
say.note: 返回锚点前后的时间线

howto.what_en: Claude can search claude-mem's cross-session memory: find an index of IDs by keyword, view the timeline around a hit, fetch full details only for filtered IDs, and pull raw tool I/O only if needed.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask about previous sessions, e.g. "did we already solve this?", "how did we do X last time?", or what happened last week.

say_en.text: How did we solve the JWT auth issue last time?
say_en.note: Searches the index first, fetches details only if needed
Returns a table of results with IDs
Returns a timeline around the anchor
